ci_support_linux_64_python3.10.____cpyth:
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.10.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: brisc
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: brisc
  version: "0.1.5"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3c065fe78348f6d941408b81bda3f8c828a86aa0a4674e83e042926177fc8107

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools >=61.0
    - wheel
    - cython >=3.0
    - numpy >=1.17.0
    - scipy >=0.16.0
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: x86_64
      then: libblas * *mkl
  run:
    - python
    - anndata
    - h5py
    - matplotlib-base >=3.5.0
    - numpy >=1.17.0
    - pandas
    - polars >=1.41.0
    - pyarrow >=0.17.0
    - r-seurat
    - ryp
    - scikit-misc
    - scipy >=0.16.0
    - threadpoolctl
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: x86_64
      then: libblas * *mkl

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - brisc

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/briscverse/brisc
  summary: Fast single-cell toolkit
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Wainberg
    - keon-arbabi
